Summary (pilot / near-term):
- Chat (20M tokens): we recommend a mid-tier chat model (e.g., chat-medium-q4). Estimated cost: $1,100 / 1M tokens -> pilot cost ~= $22k (gross before pilot cap / discounts).
- Embeddings (2M ops): embeddings-1024: roughly $12 / 1k ops equivalent (we show normalization to token-equivalent in the sheet) -> pilot cost ~= $240.
- Rerank (0.5M tokens, batched): use a low-cost rerank variant, effective $450 / 1M tokens (because of batch amortization) -> pilot cost ~= $225.

Weighted blended unit price (pilot mix): ((20M*$1,100)+(2M*($12*1000/1M))+(0.5M*$450))/(22.5M) ≈ $980 / 1M tokens.

Notes on hitting your $800 target:
- To move toward $800/1M we recommend: 1) committed tier (12mo) for a 15–25% price concession at scale; 2) enable prefix/KV cache for chat history to reduce tokenization costs; 3) activate batcher for rerank windows. With a 20% blended concession and caching gains, we project ~$760/1M at 100M monthly volume.

2) If pilot accepted, Redwood will provide an example usage policy and ephemeral keys for integration.
3) We prepare a committed-tier quote (12mo) showing breakpoints and illustrative math for your procurement.
